% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{1. Problem and dataset}
  \begin{columns}[T]
    \column{0.5\textwidth}
    \begin{itemize}
      \item bina.az sale listings (Kaggle): \NRaw{} raw rows $\to$ \NClean{} clean
      \item \textbf{Task A}: regression of $\log(\text{price})$ \\ (skewness \PriceSkew{} $\to$ \LogPriceSkew{} after the log)
      \item \textbf{Task B}: premium vs.\ standard, split at the \emph{training} median (\TierThreshold{} AZN)
      \item 70/15/15 split, stratified on price deciles: \NTrain{} / \NVal{} / \NTest
      \item Tree and SVM are \textbf{our own NumPy code}; scikit-learn only as a baseline
    \end{itemize}
    \column{0.48\textwidth}
    \fig[0.7]{eda_price_map}
  \end{columns}
\end{frame}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{2. Cleaning, features and leakage}
  \begin{columns}[T]
    \column{0.52\textwidth}
    \begin{itemize}\small
      \item Azerbaijani column names $\to$ English; strings like ``85 m$^2$'', ``5 / 9'', ``1 250 000'' parsed
      \item Prices converted to AZN at fixed rates (USD peg 1.70)
      \item Duplicates and re-posts removed; fixed plausibility rules
      \item \textbf{Leakage dropped:} \LeakageCols{} (both functions of price), plus identifiers and promo flags
      \item Imputation, one-hot levels, scaling and the tier threshold are fitted on \textbf{train only}
      \item \NFeatures{} features: size, floors, coordinates, distance to centre, flags, district one-hot
    \end{itemize}
    \column{0.46\textwidth}
    \resizebox{\linewidth}{!}{\gen{tab_cleaning}}
  \end{columns}
\end{frame}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{3. Our decision tree}
  \begin{columns}[T]
    \column{0.5\textwidth}
    \begin{itemize}\small
      \item Gini / entropy / MSE; gain $= I(p) - \sum_c \frac{N_c}{N} I(c)$
      \item Exact, vectorised search: one sort per node, every threshold scored with cumulative sums
    \end{itemize}
    \column{0.5\textwidth}
    \begin{itemize}\small
      \item \texttt{max\_depth}, \texttt{min\_samples\_split/leaf}, \texttt{min\_impurity\_decrease}
      \item Chosen on validation: A: depth \TreeRegDepth, leaf \TreeRegLeaf; B: \TreeClfCrit, depth \TreeClfDepth{} (Gini vs.\ entropy $\Delta$F1 = \CritDiff)
    \end{itemize}
  \end{columns}
  \vspace{2pt}
  \centering\fig[0.6]{tree_depth_curves}
\end{frame}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{4. Our Pegasos SVM: regularisation and margin}
  \begin{columns}[T]
    \column{0.55\textwidth}
    \small
    $J(w)=\frac{\lambda}{2}\|w\|^2+\frac1n\sum_i\max(0,\,1-y_i w^\top x_i)$\\[3pt]
    $w \leftarrow (1-\eta_t\lambda)\,w + \frac{\eta_t}{k}\sum_{i\in A_t^+} y_i x_i,\quad \eta_t = \frac{1}{\lambda t}$
    \column{0.43\textwidth}
    \begin{itemize}\small
      \item Mini-batch \SVMBatch, projection, $t$-weighted averaging
      \item $\lambda=\SVMLambda$: margin $2/\|w\|=\SVMMargin$, \SVMSVFrac{} support vectors
    \end{itemize}
  \end{columns}
  \vspace{4pt}
  \centering\fig[0.6]{svm_lambda_sweep}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{4b. Convergence and the RBF extension}
  \begin{itemize}\small
    \item $J$: \ObjFirst{} $\to$ \ObjPegasos, vs.\ LIBLINEAR's exact optimum \ObjLiblinear{} (gap \ObjGap)
    \item Random Fourier features: $\phi(x)=\sqrt{2/D}\cos(Wx+c)$, then the same linear solver ($\gamma=\RFFGamma$, $D=\RFFD$)
  \end{itemize}
  \centering
  \fig[0.36]{svm_convergence}\\
  \fig[0.36]{svm_rff_study}
\end{frame}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{5. Experimental setup}
  \begin{itemize}
    \item Every hyperparameter selected on \textbf{validation}; refit on train+val; \textbf{test scored once}
    \item Uncertainty: \CVFolds-fold stratified CV (preprocessing refitted per fold) + bootstrap CIs + paired bootstrap tests between models
    \item Task A: RMSE / MAE / $R^2$ on $\log$ price (+ AZN); Task B: P / R / F1, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC
    \item Matched baselines: \texttt{DecisionTree*}, \texttt{SGDClassifier}(hinge), \texttt{LinearSVC}, \texttt{SVC}(RBF), with scaling inside a \texttt{Pipeline}
    \item Seed 42 everywhere; \texttt{python -m src.run\_all} regenerates every number
  \end{itemize}
\end{frame}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{6. Results}
  \centering
  \resizebox{0.8\linewidth}{!}{\gen{tab_headline}}
  \vspace{0.6em}
  \begin{itemize}\small
    \item Our tree vs.\ sklearn: \RegGainMismatch{} gain mismatches, \RegAgreement{} test agreement (differences: \TreeGapCause)
    \item Averaged Pegasos within \PegasosVsLiblinearFOneDiff{} F1 of LIBLINEAR; RFF \RFFVsLinearWord{} the linear SVM (\RFFMinusLinear{} F1)
    \item Paired bootstrap on the test rows: \PairedNOursVsSkSig{} of \PairedNOursVsSk{} ours-vs-sklearn gaps are significant; tree $-$ sklearn RMSE \PairedAOurTreeVsSklearnTreeRMSEDiff{} \PairedAOurTreeVsSklearnTreeRMSECI
  \end{itemize}

  \centering\fig[0.42]{results_roc_pr}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{frame}{7. What the models use}
  \begin{itemize}\small
    \item Tree importances (MDI): \TopFeatReg
    \item Largest linear-SVM weights (standardised): $+$ \SVMPosWeights; $-$ \SVMNegWeights
  \end{itemize}
  \centering\fig[0.62]{feature_importance}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{8. Where the models fail, and limitations}
  \begin{columns}[T]
    \column{0.5\textwidth}
    \begin{itemize}\small
      \item Luxury tail: the tree \TopDecileWord{} the top decile (\TopDecileBias{} log)
      \item Sparse districts: MAE \SparseDistrictMAE{} vs.\ \DenseDistrictMAE{} in dense ones
      \item Tier errors are near-ties at the threshold
      \item Limitations: asking $\neq$ sale price; one snapshot (no time split); fixed cleaning rules; RFF depends on the seed; our tree is slower than Cython
    \end{itemize}
    \column{0.48\textwidth}
    \fig[0.7]{error_by_price_decile}
  \end{columns}
\end{frame}
